name: fail-closed-layer
means: Every finding is an objection — a charge `follow` lists and `dispose` must answer — unless a rule names it an observation: its reporter gave it `"layer": "observation"` (a grouped non-claim only when every constituent did); it gave no layer and its kind is one dwitbuk classifies as a fact (`delegated`; `review-debt` in older reviews); it is a `non-claim` about a declared setting (`where` `settings.…`) with no layer; or it is the grouped "no check decides this task" with no layer, on tasks no check could decide by nature; an unknown kind, a layer that is neither word, or a constituent the reporter called an objection leaves it an objection, and an observation stays in the review but `dispose` refuses it.
